VISA_10.4.title: Other Fraud - Card-Absent Environment
VISA_10.4.governing_clause: Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules, Section 10.4
compelling_evidence_required: Proof of 3D Secure v2.x authentication (Liability Shift)
AVS match response code (Y or Z)
IP address and device fingerprint telemetry logs
Customer invoice and proof of delivery

MASTERCARD_4837.title: No Cardholder Authorization
MASTERCARD_4837.governing_clause: Mastercard Chargeback Guide, Section 3.4 - Reason Code 4837
compelling_evidence_required: Matches on AVS and CVC2 validation
Itemized electronic receipt and IP log
